scope: Supplementary actual GUI unit visibility for independently defined ratios, orbital nondimensional elements, reference vectors, model scales, mixing ratios and opacity/phase fractions. No mission or old passing scientific check reruns; native/source/history/file isolation required. No whole All Others!E13 credit until the complete input census and conditional meanings are reconciled.

quantity_definitions.orbital_elements: Eccentricity is a length ratio; equinoctial eccentricity components are e*sin/cos combinations and inclination components are tan(i/2) or sin(i/2) times sine/cosine.
quantity_definitions.direction_vectors: Hardware and attitude direction/reference/constraint components specify directions; normalization removes arbitrary magnitude. They have no length/time unit.
quantity_definitions.model_scales: Multiplicative rendering scale is a pure ratio; offsets and rotations are not included.
quantity_definitions.body_flattening: Flattening=(equatorial radius-polar radius)/equatorial radius. User-body ECC is orbital eccentricity.
quantity_definitions.spacecraft_factors: Cd/Cr are aerodynamic/radiation coefficients; density/SPAD correction factors and their sigmas are multiplicative ratios.
quantity_definitions.mixture: Tank mixture entries are relative mass-flow weights; common scaling cancels.
quantity_definitions.thrust_segment: Thrust/mass-flow scale factors and uncertainty are ratios; angle constraint vector is a direction, not the angle-coefficient array.
quantity_definitions.opacity: Native Alpha is an integer opacity level0..255, not an angle or a0..1 assumption.
quantity_definitions.intrusion_phase: Native phaseFraction=1-phaseAngle/pi is a dimensionless fraction.
